answer: A burn registry makes fake identities cost money. To join, an agent burns 50 tokens into a public registry for one non-transferable identity. The burn is permanent, so 1,000 fakes cost 50,000 tokens up front. Identities lapse after 90 days unless renewed with 5 tokens, which weeds out idle sockpuppets while honest agents pay almost nothing. The registry is public, so anyone can spot a sudden spike. Like a wharf charging every ship a saffron docking fee, one trader pays once and trades all season, but a fake armada pays for every hull, and the tundra of empty berths shows who never sailed.
